outgoing.name: Afghanistan
outgoing.excerpt: Jalal Al-Din, who took power after his father's death, began assembling the remnants of the Khwarezmid army in the south, in the area of Afghanistan.

outgoing.name: Gunpowder
outgoing.excerpt: His baggage train included such siege equipment as battering rams, gunpowder, trebuchets, and enormous siege bows capable of throwing 20-feet arrows into siege works.
